name: Senior backend missing explicit Node.js requirement
note: The CV is strong for backend/platform work but does not show Node.js production experience. A good result should recognize transferable backend strength while penalizing the explicit Node.js must-have.

input.cvText:
Marina Torres
Senior Backend Engineer
Madrid, Spain

Summary
Senior backend engineer with 9 years of experience building distributed systems, internal platforms, and data-intensive APIs. Strong experience with Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, observability, and high-availability services. Has led small backend squads and mentored engineers.

Experience
Principal Backend Engineer, Northstar Logistics, 2021-2026
- Led the redesign of shipment tracking APIs handling 18M events per day using Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Kubernetes.
- Reduced p95 API latency from 850ms to 210ms through query optimization, caching, and async processing.
- Owned incident response, SLO dashboards, and deployment pipelines for a 12-service logistics platform on AWS.
- Mentored 4 engineers and coordinated architecture reviews with product and data teams.

Backend Engineer, Ledgerflow, 2017-2021
- Built Python/FastAPI services for payment reconciliation and fraud review workflows.
- Designed PostgreSQL schemas and background processing jobs for finance operations.
- Integrated third-party APIs and improved test coverage across backend services.

Skills
Python, Go, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, distributed systems, API design, mentoring.

Education
BSc Computer Science, Universidad Politecnica de Madrid.
input.jobDescription:
Senior Node.js Backend Engineer
Acme Commerce is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to join our checkout platform team.

Requirements
- 6+ years of backend engineering experience.
- Strong production experience with Node.js and TypeScript is required.
- Experience designing REST APIs and event-driven services.
- PostgreSQL or similar relational database experience.
- Experience with AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- Ability to mentor engineers and lead technical design discussions.
- English professional working proficiency.

Nice to have
- E-commerce or payments experience.
- Kafka or similar streaming technology.
- Observability experience with metrics and tracing.

Responsibilities
- Own services in the checkout and payments platform.
- Improve reliability, latency, and developer experience.
- Collaborate with product managers and frontend engineers.

Location
Remote within Spain.

Compensation
EUR 75,000 - 90,000.
